items.prompt: origin/main in your local repo is…
choices: A remote-tracking ref — the last-seen tip of main on origin
A second copy of your working tree
Always identical to your local main
items.explain: origin/main is updated by fetch/push; your local main moves only when you commit or merge/rebase.

choices: Updates remote-tracking refs without merging into your current branch
Is the same as git push
items.explain: Fetch refreshes origin/* pointers; pull adds integration into the checked-out branch.

items.prompt: git branch -vv shows each local branch and its upstream tracking branch.
items.explain: -vv adds upstream names and ahead/behind counts when tracking is set.

items.prompt: After a branch is deleted on the remote, locally you may run…
choices: git fetch origin && git remote prune origin
items.explain: Fetch learns the deletion; prune removes stale origin/* remote-tracking refs.
